verdict.rationale: WezTerm documents Quick Select, which highlights common text patterns so you can pick one by typing a short prefix. As documented, though, it copies the match to the clipboard rather than opening it. A community user lists 'hyperlinks' among the reasons to prefer WezTerm, which implies clickable links but without detail. missing for 10: first-party documentation of opening URLs on mouse click, documented opening of file paths, keyboard-driven open (not just copy) of a selected match, hands-on corroboration of link opening.
